verdict.rationale: The only mention of a programmatic API and MCP layer for agents is explicitly framed as a future roadmap item ('Soon, a full accounting API... will let AI agents handle bookkeeping tasks end-to-end'), not a shipped capability, and probes confirm no live OpenAPI/MCP endpoints exist today (404s on all candidate paths). While Command can draft journal entries via chat and accountants can be invited to collaborate, there is no evidence of an API-driven posting workflow or a formal 'review queue' gating agent-drafted entries for accountant approval.
